[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra I.43 (Samādhipāda) — Smṛtipariśuddhau svarūpaśūnyevārthamātranirbhāsā nirvitarkā | Pages 351-359]

attiḥ / Tathā ca vyākhyātam-- tasyā eka-buddhy-
upakramo hy artha-ātmā–aṇu-pracaya-viśeṣa-ātmā
854 gav-ādir ghaṭa-ādir vā lokaḥ / Sa ca
saṃsthāna-viśeṣo bhūta-sūkṣmāṇāṃ sādhāraṇo dharma ātma-bhūtaḥ, phalena vyaktena–
anumitaḥ sva-vyañjaka-añjanaḥ prādurbhavati, dharma-antara-udaye
855 ca tirobhavati / Sa eṣa
dharmo'vayavī–ity ucyate / Yo'sāv ekaś ca mahāṃś ca–aṇīyāṃś ca sparśavāṃś ca
856 kriyā-
dharmakaś ca–anityaś ca tena–avayavinā vyavahārāḥ kriyante / Yasya punar avastukaḥ sa
pracaya-viśeṣaḥ sūkṣmaṃ ca kāraṇam anupalabhyam avikalpasya
857 tasya–avayavy-abhāvād
atad-rūpa-pratiṣṭhaṃ mithyā-jñānam iti prāyeṇa sarvam eva
